{{Top|leg}}
A '''nanothread''' was a connecting element used on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yhifar]]. The [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]] on Yhifar used nanothreads to tether [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Submarine/Legends|submersibles]] to [[Mining/Legends|mining]] platforms.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nanothreads were mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
